command:
set -eu
BR='chatgpt-work/omega-relay-receipt-binding-20260912'
git fetch --quiet --no-tags origin "refs/heads/$BR"
SHA=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
D="/workspace/omega_runtime/state/pr2179_verify_${SHA%%????????????????????????????????????????????????????}"
mkdir -p "$D/tools" "$D/tests"
git show "$SHA:tools/omega_grid_relay.py" > "$D/tools/omega_grid_relay.py"
git show "$SHA:tools/omega_chatgpt_mcp.py" > "$D/tools/omega_chatgpt_mcp.py"
git show "$SHA:tests/test_omega_grid_relay.py" > "$D/tests/test_omega_grid_relay.py"
git show "$SHA:tests/test_omega_chatgpt_mcp.py" > "$D/tests/test_omega_chatgpt_mcp.py"
python3 -m py_compile "$D/tools/omega_grid_relay.py" "$D/tools/omega_chatgpt_mcp.py"
PYTEST=$(python3 -m pytest --version 2>&1 || true)
if python3 -m pytest --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  (cd "$D" && python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_grid_relay.py tests/test_omega_chatgpt_mcp.py)
  RC=$?
else
  RC=125
fi
printf 'PR_SHA=%s\nVERIFY_DIR=%s\nPYTEST=%s\nTEST_RC=%s\n' "$SHA" "$D" "$PYTEST" "$RC"
exit "$RC"
